transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. It's a real pleasure to meet you. I, uh... I hope I'm not taking up time you need for folks who are actually sick. 

My family, well, they're the ones who brought me in today. There was just a... a bit of a misunderstanding down at the fair recently, I suppose. I was giving my talk, and I just wanted to be helpful and give a good presentation, so I climbed up onto the tractor to show the crowd this... this new pattern I figured out. I was jerking the controls around to demonstrate it for them, and... well, I'm a little embarrassed to admit it, but I just couldn't seem to make myself stop doing it. Even with people yelling at me from the ground to get down. 

I didn't mean to cause a scene or upset anybody, I promise. I just got a little too carried away trying to show them how it worked. I hope you can understand how that happens?
Have you ever had a period like this before?

Oh, goodness, no. I... I really don't think so. I'm usually a very quiet fellow, just stick to my chores and my farm work. 

I wouldn't want you to think I make a habit of causing trouble or showing off like that. It was really just a... a rare lapse in judgment, I suppose. I've always prided myself on being pretty level-headed, you know? I just got a little too enthusiastic this one time. I hope you believe me when I say this isn't my usual way of doing things. I'm normally very well-behaved, I promise.
During that time, did you need much less sleep than usual?

Well, I suppose... maybe a little less than usual, yes. But I hope you don't think I'm neglecting my health or anything like that! It's just... well, there's always so much to do around the property, you know? 

Most nights lately, I've just been, uh, resting in my chair for maybe two or three hours. Sometimes not at all, if I'm being completely honest. But I don't want you to worry, because I feel just fine! I'm up before the sun, feeling completely charged and ready to work the place like nothing even happened. It's actually been quite productive, really. 

That's... that's not a bad thing, is it? Just being a dedicated worker and getting an early start?
Have you ever had any episodes before where your mood was this unusually elevated or energetic?

Well, I... I wouldn't call it an episode, per se. That makes it sound like something's wrong with me, and I assure you, I'm just a hard worker. But, um... I suppose there are times, especially lately, where I wake up and I just feel... wonderful. Like the whole valley is just opening up for me, you know? I'll be out there before dawn, just grinning at nothing at all because everything feels so right. 

I hope it's okay to feel that way? It's just good spirits, I think. 

But, well... I do feel awful about this part. If one of the hired hands questions how I'm doing things, or if my wife tells me I need to slow down and rest... I'm embarrassed to say it, but I just snap at them. I get so worked up, like they've insulted the family name or something. I never mean to be short with them, I really don't. It's just that I'm trying to get things done, and I feel so capable. 

That doesn't make me a bad person, does it? I just get a little too focused on the work sometimes.
During this time, have you had any experiences that other people would think were not real, such as hearing or seeing things others couldn’t?

Oh, my... well, I hope you won't think less of me for saying this. I promise you my mind is perfectly sound, I really do. I wouldn't want you to think I'm going crazy or anything like that. 

But, um... I suppose... well, sometimes out by the north pasture, especially near dusk when the day is settling down... I do hear things. It sounds like clear voices coming right out of the irrigation lines. They, uh... they tell me which rows are poisoned, and which ones are blessed. 

I know exactly how that sounds, and I'm so embarrassed to even admit it out loud to you. Please don't think I'm losing my marbles. The strange thing is, it still happens on weeks when I'm not all fired up and energetic, too. Just on regular, quiet days. 

I just try to keep my head down and keep working when it happens. That's the right thing to do, isn't it? It's probably just the wind whistling through the pipes and playing tricks on an old farmer's ears, right?
Have you ever had a previous period where you felt this elevated, energetic, or irritable for several days or longer?

Well, I... I suppose it's been going on for a little while now. I really hope you don't think I'm just running myself ragged on purpose, because I do try to take care of myself, I really do. 

But if I'm being completely honest—and I want to be honest with you—those stretches where I'm just completely charged up, not sleeping, working nonstop... well, they've taken up about ten months out of this past year or so. 

I know that sounds like a lot, and I'm a bit ashamed to admit it's been going on that long. I just kept thinking it was a good thing, you know? Getting so much done around the farm. You understand how important it is to keep a place running, don't you? I just hope I haven't let things get too out of hand.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest in things nearly every day?

Oh, no... no, I wouldn't say that. I mean, sure, farming is tough, and there are days when the weather doesn't cooperate or the crops don't yield what you hoped... and a man might feel a little down about it. But depressed? No, I... I don't think so. 

I always manage to find something to do, you know? There's always a fence to mend or a tractor to grease. I try to keep a positive outlook, I really do. I wouldn't want to be a burden to my wife by moping around the house for weeks on end. That wouldn't be right, would it? A man's got to keep his chin up and do his job. 

I hope that's the right answer. I just... I don't think I've ever felt that low for that long. I'm a pretty resilient fellow, I think.
Have you ever had a time when these symptoms stopped completely and you went back to feeling entirely like your usual self?

Well, I... I wish I could say yes, I really do. I know it would be much better if I could just tell you it all went away and I was back to my old self. I don't want to seem like a difficult case or anything. 

But if I'm being perfectly honest—and I know you need me to be honest so you can help—it's... it's just been a steady thing. This whole stretch has been going on for about a year and two months now. It all started right around the time we refinanced the property and began that big farm readjustment. 

I really thought once the paperwork was done and the new equipment was settled, I'd just bounce back to normal. That's what a person should do, right? Just handle the stress and move on. I feel terrible that I haven't been able to just shake it off. You don't think I'm just being weak about it, do you? I promise I've been trying my best to just push through it all.
Have you ever had a time when you felt so unusually energetic or full of yourself that you got into serious trouble, needed hospital care, or someone said you were clearly not yourself?

Well... I mean, I wouldn't say I got into *serious* trouble, exactly. I mean, I'm a responsible man, I really am. I always try to do what's best for the farm and my family. You believe that, don't you? 

But... I guess there was a time recently where people got a little concerned. I was just trying to get things done, you know? Moving fast, making big plans... but my wife, she... well, she and the hands kind of had to step in. I hope you don't think less of me for that. It's just... the lenders and the equipment dealers, they started getting a bit nervous about me making the calls. And my wife thought it might not be entirely safe for me to be running the heavy machinery or making the daily operational choices right then. 

There was... well, there was a bit of a scene at the county fair, too. I don't really want to get into the details because it's a bit embarrassing, but... it made folks start wondering if I was fit to keep running the place at all. I feel awful about it, I really do. I just wanted to be productive. It's normal to want to work hard and provide, isn't it? I just... maybe I took it a little too far.
Have the voices or other unusual experiences ever happened when you were not feeling unusually energized or irritable at all?

Well... I suppose... yes. I really want to be completely honest with you, even though it's a little hard to admit. I hope you don't think I'm completely losing my mind, I really do. 

There was a stretch—several quieter weeks, actually—where I wasn't feeling all wound up or... or energized or grand, like I was during that incident at the fair. I was just feeling pretty calm, just trying to go about my day and do my chores. But... well, I still heard the lines talking. And I still firmly believed that all the farm data, the yield reports and such, were carrying these hidden warnings meant for me. 

I know how strange that sounds to say out loud. I kept it to myself mostly because I didn't want to upset my wife or make anyone think I couldn't handle my responsibilities. It's just a trick of the stress, right? You don't think I'm a hopeless case for experiencing those things even when I was perfectly calm, do you? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information so I can get back to being a good, reliable provider for my family.
Have there been any times when the voices or unusual beliefs kept happening for at least two weeks while your mood was completely normal?

Well, yes, actually. I... I think I just mentioned that, but I want to make sure I'm answering exactly what you need. I really do want to get this right. 

Like I said, there was that stretch—it was definitely more than two weeks, maybe a few weeks—where my mood was completely level. I wasn't feeling high-strung or overly important or anything like that. I was just feeling like my regular, steady self, just trying to get the day's work done. But... yes, during that whole time, I was still hearing the lines talking to me. And I was still absolutely certain that the yield reports and the data had those hidden warnings in them. 

I know it probably sounds silly that I'd still be dealing with that when I was feeling so calm and normal otherwise. I hope that's the kind of detail you were looking for? I just want to be sure I'm not overcomplicating things for you.

During the times you felt unusually energetic and slept much less, did you ever need to be hospitalized or have your family keep you from taking care of the farm because you were clearly out of control?

Well... yes, sir, I suppose so. I mean, I touched on it a little earlier, but... I didn't actually go to the hospital. I wouldn't want you to think I was completely out of control, like I was dangerous or anything. I just... I had a lot of energy, and I guess it was a bit much for everyone else.

But, yes, my wife and the hands... they did have to step in and take over the decisions I usually make. The lenders and the equipment folks were getting uneasy, and... well, my wife didn't feel it was safe for me to be running the tractors or making the daily calls for the farm. And then... after that incident at the fair I mentioned, folks really started questioning if I was fit to keep running the place at all. 

I'm usually a very capable man, I promise you that. It's just... during that time, they felt they had to keep me from the work. I hope you can understand, it's hard for a man who's worked the land his whole life to admit he had to be sidelined. I'm just trying to give you the whole picture so you can help me get back to normal. Is that the kind of information you needed?
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest or pleasure in things nearly every day?

Well, no... I don't think so. I mean, sure, everyone gets a little down now and then, especially when the weather doesn't cooperate or the yields are lower than you hoped. It's just part of farming, you know? But... no, I haven't ever felt like I couldn't get out of bed or like I didn't care about the farm for weeks on end. 

I've always taken a lot of pride in my work, and even when things are tough, I still want to be out there doing my part. I wouldn't let myself just give up on it like that. I try to keep a positive attitude, for my family's sake. I hope that's alright? I mean, it's a good thing I haven't felt that way, right? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers so we can get this all sorted out.
Have there ever been times when the voices or fixed beliefs continued even while you were having no manic symptoms at all?

Well, yes, sir... I think we might have just touched on that a moment ago, but I want to be absolutely sure I'm giving you exactly what you need. 

Like I was saying, there was definitely a stretch of time—several weeks, really—where things were... well, quiet. I wasn't feeling all wound up, and I didn't have any of those big ideas about myself. I was just feeling like my normal, everyday self, just trying to keep the farm running smooth. 

But... yes, even during those quiet weeks when I felt perfectly fine, I was still hearing the lines talking to me out in the fields. And... I still firmly believed that the yield reports and the farm data were carrying those hidden warnings. 

I know it probably sounds a bit strange to have those things happening when I wasn't feeling keyed up or energized at all. I really hope I'm not repeating myself too much or making this confusing for you. I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions the right way so you have everything you need to help me. Does that make sense?
Have there ever been any times when the voices or beliefs were completely gone and you felt entirely back to your usual self?

Well, sir... that's a good question. I... I'd like to say yes. I really would. I want to tell you that everything just cleared up and went back to the way it used to be. 

But... if I'm being completely honest, and I know you need me to be honest so you can do your job... no. They haven't ever completely gone away. Even when I'm feeling perfectly level-headed, not too high and not too low, just going about my chores... there's always a murmur out there in the fields. Or I'll look at the ledger and just... know there's something else written between the lines. 

It's quieter sometimes, sure. Easier to ignore so I can get my work done. But it's never just... gone. I haven't felt entirely like my old self in a long time. 

I'm sorry if that's not the answer you were hoping for. I know it probably makes my case a bit more complicated, doesn't it? I really am trying my best to handle it all, I promise. I just... I hope that's alright to admit.
Have you ever had the voices or fixed beliefs only when you were feeling unusually high or energized, or did they also happen when your mood was normal?

Well, sir... I know we might be circling back to this a bit, and I really hope I'm not confusing things. I want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need for your notes. 

But yes, just like I mentioned a little bit ago... they definitely happen when my mood is completely normal, too. There were several weeks not too long ago that were just... well, nice and quiet. I wasn't feeling especially energized, and I didn't have any of those grand ideas or anything like that. I was just my regular self, doing my chores. 

But even during those quiet weeks, I still heard the lines talking out there in the fields. And... I still fully believed that the farm data was carrying those hidden warnings. It wasn't just when I was feeling high or wound up. 

I hope it's okay that I'm repeating myself a little here. I just want to make absolutely sure I'm answering your questions the right way. Am I doing alright with these answers? I really want to be helpful to you.
Have the voices or beliefs ever continued for at least two weeks while your mood was completely normal?

Well, yes, sir... I know we've touched on this a few times now, and I really hope I'm not being a bother by repeating myself. I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly the details you need for your assessment. 

But yes, absolutely. Like I was saying, there was that stretch—definitely at least two weeks, maybe a little more—where things were just... quiet. I wasn't feeling wound up or grand or anything like that. Just my normal self, doing my regular chores. But even during those normal, quiet weeks, the voices out in the fields were still there. And I still firmly believed the yield reports were sending me those warnings. 

I hope it's alright that I keep coming back to that same example. I just want to be sure I'm answering you correctly. Is this the kind of information you're looking for? I really want to make sure I'm being a good patient for you.
Have your mood symptoms, like feeling unusually high or irritable, been present for most of the time that you've had the voices and beliefs?

Well, sir... I suppose... yes, for the most part. I really don't want to make it sound like I'm always difficult or... or out of control. I pride myself on being a hard worker, you know? 

But... if I look back at the whole time since this all started... yes, for the majority of it, I've had that... that charged-up feeling. I'd be running on barely any sleep, making all these big, grand plans for the farm, and... well, I'm not proud of this part, but I'd snap at my hands or my wife if they tried to slow me down or tell me to rest. 

I know that doesn't paint me in the best light, and I really am usually a much more even-tempered man. I just... I get so driven by what I think I need to do. I hope you don't think too poorly of me for that. I'm just trying to give you the whole picture, like you asked. Is that... is that helpful for your notes?
Have you ever had the voices or fixed beliefs continue for at least two weeks when you were not having any manic symptoms at all?

Well, sir... yes. I know we're sort of covering the same ground again, and I really hope I'm not being frustrating or... or unhelpful by repeating myself. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers.

But yes, like I mentioned before, there were definitely a few weeks—maybe even a month or so—where things were just... quiet. I wasn't feeling all wound up, and I didn't have any of those big, grand ideas about expanding the farm or anything. I was just waking up, having my coffee, and doing my chores like a normal, steady man. 

But... even during those nice, quiet weeks, when I wasn't feeling charged up at all... I still heard the lines talking out there in the fields. And I still fully believed that the yield reports were carrying those hidden warnings. It didn't stop just because I felt calm. 

I hope it's okay that I brought that same time period up again. I just want to make sure I'm answering exactly what you're asking. Does that make sense, sir? Am I giving you what you need?
Have there ever been any stretches of at least two weeks when you had no voices or fixed unusual beliefs at all?

Well, sir... no, not really. I hope that's an alright answer. I know I've been talking your ear off about all this, and I don't want to sound like I'm making a bigger deal out of things than I should. I'm usually a very grounded fella, you know? Just put my head down and do the work. 

But... if I'm being completely honest, and I want to make sure I'm giving you the most accurate picture I can... those voices out in the fields, and the warnings in the yield reports... they haven't really stopped at all. It's been going on for about 11 months now. Just a steady thing. 

I know that probably sounds a bit strange, and I hope you don't think I'm completely losing my grip. I still manage the farm and take care of my responsibilities. But yes, it's been about 11 months without a break from it. Is that... is that the kind of timeline you were looking for? I just want to make sure I'm being helpful.
